content: Uptime-monitor product conventions (training knowledge, competitor pages unreachable during research — LOW): minute-granularity intervals, windowed uptime 24h/7d/30d on status pages, multi-location probes, maintenance windows, alert retries/debounce, integrations (Slack/PagerDuty/webhook/email), public status pages with incident history; SpiderNode v1 deliberately preserves 1-strike DOWN + lifetime counters for behavior compatibility, deferring windowed uptime to final UI phase.
